OmniCalc is an offline-first calculator suite: a standard calculator with history and memory, a scientific mode, formula and unit tools, and a library that keeps your calculations, favorites and preferences — designed to feel local first in Bangladesh, then everywhere.

• Standard and scientific calculators with live preview
• History, favorites and memory
• Bangla/English interface with ৳, South Asian grouping and Bengali numerals
• Configurable angle, percent, precision and grouping behavior
• Works fully offline — no account, no tracking

OmniCalc requests no permissions, collects no data and connects to no servers. Calculations, favorites and preferences are stored only on this device, and you can clear them at any time from Library → History or Settings → Reset.

Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, AndroidX (Core, Splash Screen, AppCompat), Material Components, Room and DataStore — each under its own Apache 2.0 / BSD / Apache-style open-source license. OmniCalc itself is provided by the developer as-is.
